job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer to join our team at Cloud202, playing a crucial role in developing and implementing artificial intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in AI concepts and experience working with various AI technologies.



Roles and Responsibility




Design and develop scalable AI models and algorithms to solve complex problems.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI into existing systems and applications.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.


Work on natural language processing, computer vision, and other AI techniques.


Participate in code reviews and ensure high-quality code standards.


Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and deep learning.




Job Requirements




Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning.


Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.


Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


Strong communication and interpersonal skills.




Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
